remarks: Welcome to this charming 3-bedroom, 2-bath ranch home nestled in the heart of Springdale! Offering a perfect blend of modern updates and classic comfort, this home is sure to impress. Step inside to discover a spacious, open floor plan ideal for both everyday living and entertaining. The brand-new kitchen is a true highlight, featuring sleek countertops, stainless steel appliances, and ample cabinetry - perfect for preparing meals and gathering with loved ones. The open flow between the kitchen and living areas creates a bright, airy space that you'll love spending time in. The master suite has been beautifully upgraded with a brand-new en-suite bathroom, providing a serene retreat after a long day. Two additional bedrooms with plenty of space and flexibility, whether you're creating a home office, guest room, or cozy personal space. The fully finished basement provides even more room to spread out, with endless possibilities for a family room, home gym, or hobby space. Enjoy the outdoors from your new deck, perfect for summer barbecues, relaxing with a book, or enjoying the fresh air. Don't miss your chance to make it yours!
